decisions.reason: Replacing the rail-monitoring IC does not change the standalone regulator, source-selection behavior, or loads powered by the shared 3.3V rail.
The monitoring-IC replacement does not change the 5V rail converter, GPIO switching, powered loads, or shutdown behavior.
The AXP2101 battery and USB power-path topology remains valid independently of which IC monitors downstream rail current.
Changing INA219 to INA3221 does not necessarily alter the established interboard connectors, pinouts, board chain, or power-distribution topology.
The LED 5V supply and required data-level shifting remain unchanged by the current-monitor IC selection.
The monitoring-IC replacement has no entailed effect on the battery connector series, mounting, or unresolved pinout.
The BOOT and reset controls and their capacitance values are independent of rail-current monitoring.
Replacing the current monitor does not change the selected ESP32-S3 module or its breakout requirement.
USB-C enumeration and programming behavior are unaffected by the rail-monitoring IC selection.
The decision to replace INA219 does not change the LED power-cutoff behavior, control GPIO, or standby-current target.
Although the replacement monitor is an I2C device, the source decision does not entail any change to bus speed, pull-ups, cabling, or signal-conditioning values.
The current-monitor selection has no entailed effect on battery connector placement, orientation, spacing, or mounting-hole clearance.
